mapper.select: SELECT id, factoryName, address, phone, createTime, need_id, factoryLatitude, factoryLongitude FROM factory ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO factory (factoryName, address, phone, createTime, need_id, factoryLatitude, factoryLongitude) VALUES (#{factoryName}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{createTime}, #{needId}, #{factoryLatitude}, #{factoryLongitude})
mapper.update: UPDATE factory SET factoryName = #{factoryName}, address = #{address}, phone = #{phone}, need_id = #{needId}, factoryLatitude = #{factoryLatitude}, factoryLongitude = #{factoryLongitude} WHERE id = #{id}
